opening.argument: The presentation directly solicits participation in Mirror Trading International by instructing viewers to register through the speaker and provide at least $100 in Bitcoin. It pairs that payment request with recurring weekday returns described as 0.3% to 1.4%, presenting passive earnings and financial freedom as attainable. The opportunity also depends on a two-leg referral structure, including direct bonuses, team growth, spillover, and a weaker leg, while advertising residual income of up to $75,000 per week. The seven-day funding deadline and warning that unpaid members may be flushed from the system add pressure to participate. A trading-risk disclaimer does not outweigh this direct solicitation and the accompanying earning claims.
